identification.summary: Malpedia, citing TeamT5 reporting, describes SLIME88 as a China-nexus APT that exploited Apache ActiveMQ CVE-2026-34197 to deploy the SoxAgent RAT on Linux devices and set up an ORB network tracked as GOBLIN14. It reports targeting of IT and manufacturing entities in the US, South Korea, India and France, and of Taiwan's energy sector via phishing emails and fake certificate installers delivering AdaptixC2 and Cobalt Strike, and says the group uses Cloudflare to obscure C2 IP addresses [S2].
identification.notes: SLIME88 is TeamT5's name. No Microsoft name or MITRE group ID is established in the sources gathered. Malpedia carries the SLIME88 entry citing TeamT5 reporting [S2]. Do not merge with Magnet Goblin (a separate group that also abused ActiveMQ flaws) or with other China-nexus ORB clusters; no source links them to SLIME88.

attribution.confidence: SLIME88 is labelled 'China-nexus' in the Malpedia entry (citing TeamT5); the sources gathered state no government sponsor and no confidence level [S2].
attribution.basis: Vendor assessment by TeamT5 as relayed by Malpedia; the underlying evidence was not accessible [S2].

targeting.notes: IT and manufacturing victims in the US, South Korea, India and France are reported for the ActiveMQ exploitation; the Taiwan energy-sector targeting is reported separately and involved phishing [S2].

capabilities.summary: Exploitation of Apache ActiveMQ CVE-2026-34197: an authenticated attacker can abuse the Jolokia API to make the broker load a remote Spring XML configuration, giving code execution [S3]. CISA added CVE-2026-34197 to its KEV catalog in April 2026 [S3]. Post-exploitation tooling is the SoxAgent Linux RAT, with an ORB network tracked as GOBLIN14 [S2]. Against Taiwan's energy sector, phishing with fake certificate installers delivers AdaptixC2 and Cobalt Strike [S2]. Cloudflare is used to obscure C2 IP addresses [S2].

campaigns.name: ActiveMQ CVE-2026-34197 exploitation and GOBLIN14 ORB build
campaigns.summary: SLIME88 exploited CVE-2026-34197 to deploy SoxAgent RAT on Linux devices and build the GOBLIN14 ORB network, with IT and manufacturing victims in the US, South Korea, India and France. Exact dates not confirmed [S2].

campaigns.name: CISA KEV listing of CVE-2026-34197
campaigns.summary: CVE-2026-34197 was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in April 2026. Fixed versions are 5.19.4 and 6.2.3. This listing is not attributed to SLIME88 [S3].

campaigns.name: Taiwan energy sector phishing
campaigns.summary: Malpedia, citing TeamT5, reports phishing emails and fake certificate installers aimed at Taiwan's energy sector to deploy AdaptixC2 and Cobalt Strike backdoors. Exact dates were not found [S2].

diamond.adversary: China-nexus cluster named SLIME88 by TeamT5; no sponsor identified [S2].
diamond.capability: ActiveMQ CVE-2026-34197 exploit, SoxAgent Linux RAT, AdaptixC2, Cobalt Strike, phishing with fake certificate installer [S2].
diamond.infrastructure: GOBLIN14 ORB network; Cloudflare fronting of C2 [S2].
diamond.victim: IT and manufacturing entities in the US, South Korea, India and France; Taiwan energy sector [S2].
diamond.technology: Internet-exposed Apache ActiveMQ Classic brokers with the Jolokia endpoint reachable; unpatched versions before 5.19.4 or 6.2.3 [S3].

gaps: TeamT5's original post was not found in search results and its URL was removed as unverified; details rest on Malpedia's summary of TeamT5 reporting. The earlier 7 April 2026 first-observed date and SoxAgent C2 indicators were removed as unsupported.
Publication date of the TeamT5 alert is not confirmed; 2026-06 is inferred from the Malpedia entry's reference to a June 2026 TeamT5 report [S2].
No independent second-vendor reporting on SLIME88 was found; Strobes and Malpedia entries appear to repeat the same underlying text.
No sponsor, objectives, MITRE ID, Microsoft name or aliases are established.
Dates, victims and technical details of the Taiwan energy campaign are not available.
Relationship between GOBLIN14 and other publicly named China-nexus ORB networks is unknown.

provenance.importedSummary: SLIME88 is a China-nexus APT that has exploited the critical vulnerability CVE-2026-34197 in Apache ActiveMQ to deploy SoxAgent RAT, compromising Linux devices and establishing an ORB network tracked as GOBLIN14. The group has targeted IT and manufacturing entities in the US, South Korea, India, and France. Additionally, SLIME88 has aimed at Taiwan’s energy sector using phishing emails and fake certificate installers to deploy backdoor programs like AdaptixC2 and CobaltStrike. They often utilize Cloudflare to obscure their C2 IP addresses, evading detection.
